name: Jarvis II — Generic RAG Core VNext No-Evidence Acceptance Driver

parameters.jsCode: const token=String($env.GPT_BIGGY_PROPOSE_TOKEN||'').trim();if(!token)throw new Error('VNext authentication fixture is unavailable');return [{json:{body:{query:'Ask Jarvis for a wiring schematic for a 9999-ZZ99',correlation_id:'vnext-acceptance-no-evidence',caller:'inactive-acceptance-driver'},headers:{authorization:'Bearer '+token}}}];

const b=$json.body&&typeof $json.body==='object'?$json.body:{};const h=$json.headers&&typeof $json.headers==='object'?$json.headers:{};const expected=String($env.GPT_BIGGY_PROPOSE_TOKEN||'').trim();const supplied=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,'').trim();const query=String(b.query||b.objective||'').trim();const correlationId=String(b.correlation_id||b.correlationId||'').trim();if(!expected||supplied!==expected)return [{json:{ok:false,status:401,error:'authenticated GUI ingress required',correlation_id:correlationId||null}}];if(!query||query.length>1000)return [{json:{ok:false,status:400,error:'query must be 1 to 1000 characters',correlation_id:correlationId||null}}];return [{json:{ok:true,query,correlation_id:correlationId||null,caller:String(b.caller||b.source||'gui').slice(0,40)}}];

const request=$('Validate Read-Only RAG Request').first().json;const raw=$json.body&&typeof $json.body==='object'?$json.body:{};const first=Array.isArray(raw.pages)?raw.pages[0]||{}:{};const page=Number(first.pdf_page)||null;const relativeUrl=String(raw.url||'');const pageUrl=relativeUrl&&page?relativeUrl+'#page='+page:relativeUrl||null;const verified=raw.ok===true&&raw.status==='VERIFIED_EVIDENCE'&&Boolean(raw.source)&&Boolean(page);const answer=verified?'I found verified wiring evidence for '+String(raw.catalog_term||'the requested equipment')+' in '+String(raw.source).split('/').pop()+', PDF page '+page+'.':'I could not verify a wiring-schematic page in the engineering library for that request.';return [{json:{ok:verified,schema:'jarvis.ii.rag_evidence.vnext.v1',status:verified?'COMPLETED':'NO_VERIFIED_EVIDENCE',correlation_id:request.correlation_id,caller:request.caller,answer,speak:answer,spoken_text:answer,spoken_reply:answer,citations:verified?[{source:raw.source,url:pageUrl,pdf_page:page,excerpt:String(first.excerpt||'')}]:[],rag_evidence:verified?{provider:'jarvis-ii-generic-rag-core',retrieval:raw.retrieval,catalog_term:raw.catalog_term,source:raw.source,pages:raw.pages}:null}}];

const r=$json;const failures=[];if(r.schema!=='jarvis.ii.rag_evidence.vnext.v1')failures.push('schema');if(r.status!=='NO_VERIFIED_EVIDENCE')failures.push('status');if(typeof r.spoken_text!=='string'||r.spoken_text!=='I could not verify a wiring-schematic page in the engineering library for that request.')failures.push('natural_spoken_text');if(!Array.isArray(r.citations)||r.citations.length!==0)failures.push('citations');if(r.rag_evidence!==null)failures.push('rag_evidence');if(r.spoken_text!==r.answer||r.speak!==r.answer||r.spoken_reply!==r.answer)failures.push('single_response_contract');return [{json:{acceptance:'vnext_authenticated_no_verified_evidence',passed:failures.length===0,failures,status:r.status,correlation_id:r.correlation_id,spoken_text:r.spoken_text,citation_count:r.citations.length,n8n_output_items:1}}];
